## 1. Identity
- Stack entry `L4bdd521a.BRF80_40`, NY PM (session code 4, ET 12:00-16:00). Cell: row `tm1800`, module `trig_xmarket_ym`, variant `follow`, w 5, thr 1.0, mode both. Events file /mnt/l2/l2vast/_brkt/ev/L4bdd521a_R0_F80_40.parquet (1,554 events: 784 long, 770 short; stop_pts = 80, tgt_pts = 40, lots 1 on every row, checked). Engine base set TL3_ALN_NP_L4bdd521a_R0BRF80_40 (months to 202610 landed).
- Entries per day (signals): mean 1.97, median 2, p90 3, max 6 over 788 days; last 20 days mean 1.5. Engine trades per day (days with a trade, 2026): mean 1.58, median 1, max 4; last 20 days 1.5. Sample days: 20261027 = 1 signal, 1 trade; 20261110 = 0 signals.

## 2. Bar: tm1800 (30-minute epoch-aligned time bar)
Code: time bars of the engine's own store (code/th_swap/common.py row_dir TB = /mnt/l2/l2vast/_major_sw/tbars/tm1800/), rule D8_BAR_DEFS.md 3.1 / section 8. Only the KNOWN TIME of the bar is used by the trigger; OHLC does not matter.
- bucket = floor(record timestamp UTC seconds / 1800): boundaries at every :00 and :30 of the clock hour (identical in ET); every tape RECORD counts (no print merge: time bars are unaffected by the D8 print rule). o/h/l/c = first / max / min / last record price, volume = sum of sizes, delta = sum of side x size. No bar for an empty bucket. One continuous series over all sessions, no reset.
- Known time = max(nominal bucket end, timestamp of the first record of the next EXISTING bucket) (e.g. td 20261110: 17:00:00.008Z for the bucket ending 17:00:00Z). Session of a bar = by NOMINAL END time: the NY PM bars are the bars with nominal end 12:00, 12:30, ..., 15:30 ET (8 bars; 17:00Z ... 20:30Z in EST) with part = 0; the bar ending 16:00 ET is session code 5 and cannot signal (data check: the stored code-4 bars per day are exactly these 8). The bar ending 12:00 ET (17:00Z in EST, 16:00Z in EDT) is the FIRST NY PM bar.
- VERIFIED: rebuilt from the tape: td 20261027 and td 20261110, 8 of 8 NY PM bars equal on known time and OHLCV.
- No daily scale for this row. (For completeness the engine day-scale tables used by the other rows have holes on 1102-1105; see section 6: they play no role here.)

## 3. Trigger: trig_xmarket_ym follow, w 5, thr 1.0 (exact rule)
Code: code/th_grid/triggers_d/xm_ym.py + xm_base.py + fd_xm.py + fd_common.py:46-57 edge; independent copy: code/d8_spec4/check4.py `minute_store`, `ret`, `zseries`, `trig_other`.
1. Series: Databento ohlcv-1m of YM (CBOT E-mini Dow, front-month by calendar, file /mnt/l2/l2vast/_alpha_breadth/YM_1m.parquet, ts_event = minute START) and the NQ 1-minute closes of the engine minute store (/mnt/l2/l2vast/_bars/feat_d/nq1m.npz, minute START, closes in points), both put on one dense 1-minute grid starting at the first NQ minute (2023-04-02 22:00 UTC); a missing minute = NaN; the instrument id of each minute is kept (YM id 42004778 on the sample days).
2. A minute is KNOWN at start + 60 s. For a bar with known time T (whole seconds) the minute used is k = floor(T / 60) - 1 on the grid (start = floor(T/60) x 60 - 60), i.e. the last COMPLETED minute (example: bar known 17:00:00.008Z uses the minute starting 16:59:00Z).
3. r5_YM = YM close(k) / YM close(k-5) - 1; r5_NQ = NQ close(k) / NQ close(k-5) - 1 (float32 arithmetic in the engine; NaN if either end is missing or the instrument id changed anywhere inside the 5-minute window, or fewer than 5 earlier minutes). rel = r5_YM - r5_NQ.
4. sigma = sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of `rel` over the 4,320 grid minutes BEFORE minute k (rolling window of 4,320 grid positions ending at k-1, current minute excluded), computed over valid values only, at least 600 valid values else NaN (check4.py zseries: `rolling(4320, min_periods=600).std().shift(1)`). 4,320 = 3 days of 1,440 grid minutes (a gap in the data stays in the window as NaN, it does not extend the window). z = rel / sigma; z NaN counts as 0 at the bar.
5. UP level = z >= +1.0, DOWN level = z <= -1.0 (inclusive); EDGE: kept only if the level was False at the PREVIOUS BAR of the series (all sessions, tm1800 bars every 30 minutes, first bar of the series False). Series of ALL sessions: the previous bar of the first NY PM bar is the bar before it (the 16:30Z-style NY AM bar).
6. FOLLOW: LONG on the UP edge, SHORT on the DOWN edge; both on the same bar -> dropped. Sides both. Signal bar must be code 4 with part = 0.
VERIFIED: check4 logic = engine events 1,554 / 1,554; my table below reproduces the stored signals (1 SHORT signal on 20261027 at the bar known 17:00:00.004Z, z -1.133; 0 on 20261110).

## 4. Data NT8 needs
YM 1-minute closes (completed minute bars) plus the YM contract id (or roll flag), NQ 1-minute closes and id, and 3 days (4,320 minutes) of both for sigma at the first bar of the day (so the strategy must be running with history loaded). The YM/NQ minute closes must come from the same calendar grid (whole minutes). A completed YM minute must be available before every tm1800 known time (at most a few seconds late). The YM calendar front-month roll in Databento versus the NT8 continuous contract: OPEN.

## 5. Bracket, sides, window, one position
- Bracket: stop 80.0, target 40.0 points from the entry fill, fixed, 1 lot (no unit rule). Sides: both. Window: NY PM bars as in section 2; exit at 16:00 ET + 1 s.
**Signal to engine event (VERIFIED in code).** Event time = floor(known time of the signal bar to whole seconds) + 2 s (code/th_nyeng/ny_build.py:32); events with ts >= the session-end instant are dropped (ny_build.py:33); session-end instant = next ET boundary after the signal bar (code/th_swap/common.py:32-40; NY PM = 16:00 ET = 21:00:00Z in EST, 20:00:00Z in EDT); exit cap N = 120 s (code/th_fakefill/cap_exit.py). Only bars of session code 4 (ET 12:00-16:00; code/th_swap/common.py:41-44) with part = 0 can signal. **One-position / fill / exits (text of D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2), simulator code/replica/sim.py, NOT re-verified here).** MARKET order at event time, filled 1.0 s later walking the 10-level book; stop = stop order at fill -/+ stop_pts, target = resting limit at fill +/- tgt_pts; ONE position per book (an event while in a trade / exit pending / entry in flight is dropped); scheduled session-end exit 16:00 ET + 1.0 s (120 s last-print rule); roll: flat 1 ns before the roll second, entries skipped roll-120 s to roll+300 s. 1 lot per book in the engine runs (bare R0).
